string_cost: row-normalized negative log class probability; impossible strings receive cost 1000; lambda selected on session 02

lambda_validation.tie_break: highest feasible-note string accuracy; lower lambda if tied

predicted_notes_test.source: same mtab transcripts used in the 57-entry AutoTab head-to-head; the three unscored entries have no transcript file

caveats: The oracle-note score excludes physically infeasible annotations; it is not end-to-end accuracy.
The predicted-note result is conditioned on the existing notes and measures string/fret assignment only.
The 57-entry predicted-note set is the same-set AutoTab comparison, not a full 60-entry rerun.
GuitarSet labels include annotation errors and possible hexaphonic pickup bleed; this is a single dataset split.
No source separation or audio-transcription changes were made in this experiment.
